title: Partner Capability Estimation for Task-Agnostic Adaptation in Ad-Hoc Teamwork

extra.description: Effective collaboration with novel and diverse partners is a crucial skill for autonomous agents. Most current ad-hoc teamwork (AHT) approaches assume that agents will collaborate on a single, fixed task and that the partner's capabilities, their ability to successfully execute the desired action, are already known.
